$roomCode..write: auth != null && $roomCode.matches(/^[A-Z0-9]{6}$/) && (!data.exists() || data.child('guestId').val() === '' || (newData.child('hostId').val() === data.child('hostId').val() && (newData.child('guestId').val() === data.child('guestId').val() || data.child('guestId').val() === '')))
